Done. All three deliverables are in place, and the DOCX was rendered to PDF/PNG to visually verify the layout (temp render artifacts cleaned up afterward).

**Deliverables**

- `bailuzhou_lib_1014.txt` — the full transcript, 42 lines from `[14:00]` to `[14:41]`, extracted verbatim from `brief.md`.
- `out/纪要.docx` — three-part meeting minutes, title "白鹭洲图书馆十周年活动筹备会议纪要", plus a meeting-info header table and a repeating header row on the todo table.
- `out/summary.json` — the four requested counts: 决议事项 6 / 待办事项 22 / 风险与关注 9 / 合计 37.
- `build_minutes.py` — the generator, kept so the documents can be regenerated or amended.

**Content decisions worth flagging**

The transcript is mostly statements of fact and proposals, so I split items by what they actually are rather than by department:

- **决议事项 (6)** — only what the chair actually ruled on: exhibit list finalized today (14:03), opening ceremony at 9:00 on Nov 1 (14:08), donation ceremony merged into the opening (14:14), the three-part conclusion — ten-day run, no reservation required, closing extended one hour (14:21), overtime catering charged to union funds (14:27), and gift-bag counts computed from the Oct 25 registration number (14:25/14:26).
- **待办事项 (22)** — a 6-column table: 序号 / 待办事项 / 责任方 / 完成时限 / 状态 / 时间戳. Every row carries the source timestamp(s) so each item is traceable to the transcript.
- **风险与关注 (9)** — items the speaker explicitly flagged as uncertain or hazardous (backup lock delivery threatening the build schedule, the overdue-fee waiver awaiting a ruling with a 15th-of-month deadline, volunteer insurance blocking deployment), rated 高/中 and tied to the responsible party.

Two items had no owner named in the transcript — the media invitation template hand-off (14:33) and the borrowing-limit question (14:04). I recorded 责任方 as "责任方未明确" rather than assigning one, since inventing a name would misrepresent the meeting. The borrowing limit is listed as a risk, not a decision, because 远山 never ruled on it. The transcript's final line (tea break on the second floor at 14:41) is logistics chatter rather than any of the three categories, so it appears only in the transcript file.
